calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

calls.name: describe_data
calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

input.query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.PRD_CD AS product_ndc, s.SUBST_NM, s.UNII_CD
FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p
JOIN wh.T_PRD_INGR i ON i.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK
JOIN wh.T_SUBST_MSTR s ON s.SUBST_SK = i.SUBST_SK
WHERE (s.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%POTASSIUM CHLORIDE%' OR s.UNII_CD = '660YQ98I10'
   OR s.SUBST_SK IN (SELECT sm.SUBST_SK FROM wh.X_SALT_MOIETY sm JOIN wh.T_SUBST_MSTR m ON m.SUBST_SK = sm.MOIETY_SUBST_SK WHERE m.UNII_CD='660YQ98I10'))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wh.T_PRD_RTE r JOIN wh.T_REF_CD rc ON rc.CD_VAL = r.RTE_CD AND rc.CD_DOM='RTE' WHERE r.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK AND rc.CD_DSC ILIKE '%ORAL%')
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.PRD_CD, s.SUBST_NM, s.UNII_CD, rc.CD_DSC
FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p
JOIN wh.T_PRD_INGR i ON i.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK
JOIN wh.T_SUBST_MSTR s ON s.SUBST_SK = i.SUBST_SK
LEFT JOIN wh.T_PRD_RTE r ON r.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK
LEFT JOIN wh.T_REF_CD rc ON rc.CD_VAL = r.RTE_CD AND rc.CD_DOM='RTE'
WHERE s.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%POTASSIUM CHLORIDE%' OR s.UNII_CD = '660YQ98I10'
ORDER BY 1;

queries.query:

JOIN wh.T_SUBST_MSTR s ON s.SUBST_SK = i.SUBST_SK

AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wh.T_PRD_RTE r JOIN wh.T_REF_CD rc ON rc.CD_VAL = r.RTE_CD AND rc.CD_DOM='RTE' WHERE r.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK AND rc.CD_DSC ILIKE '%ORAL%')
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.PRD_CD, s.SUBST_NM, s.UNII_CD, rc.CD_DSC

WHERE s.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%POTASSIUM CHLORIDE%' OR s.UNII_CD = '660YQ98I10'
ORDER BY 1;

input.query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.PRD_CD AS product_ndc, o.ORG_NM, d.CD_DSC AS form, r.CD_DSC AS route
FROM wh.T_PKG k
JOIN wh.T_ORG_MSTR o ON o.ORG_SK = k.LBLR_ORG_SK
JOIN wh.T_PRD_MSTR p ON p.PRD_SK = k.PRD_SK
LEFT JOIN wh.T_REF_CD d ON d.CD_DOM='DSG_FRM' AND d.CD_VAL = p.DSG_FRM_CD
JOIN wh.T_PRD_RTE pr ON pr.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK
JOIN wh.T_REF_CD r ON r.CD_DOM='RTE' AND r.CD_VAL = pr.RTE_CD
WHERE (o.ORG_NM ILIKE '%sun pharma%' OR o.ORG_CD ILIKE '%sun-pharma%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wh.X_ORG_ALIAS a WHERE a.ORG_SK=o.ORG_SK AND a.ALIAS_NM ILIKE '%sun pharma%'))
AND d.CD_DSC ILIKE '%SOLUTION%' AND r.CD_DSC ILIKE '%TOPICAL%'

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

  version: "1.0.0"
  description: "Semantic layer over the drug data warehouse (schema wh): FDA drug products and packages, their ingredients and labelers, adverse event reports and recalls. Query the views in schema sem; codes are already decoded into labels, dates are real dates and flags are booleans."
  entities:
    - name: "product"
      view: "sem.products"
      grain: "one row per product (product NDC)"
      description: "Drug products as listed in the FDA NDC directory, one row per product NDC (labeler and product code)."
      primary_key: "product_ndc"
      synonyms:
        - "drug product"
        - "NDC product"
        - "drug"
        - "medication"
      dimensions:
        - name: "product_ndc"
          type: "text"
          description: "Product NDC in 4-4, 5-3 or 5-4 form."
        - name: "product_name"
          type: "text"
          description: "Name as listed."
          synonyms:
            - "brand name"
            - "trade name"
        - name: "dosage_form"
          type: "text"
          description: "Dosage form as written in the source. Values are FDA SPL dosage form terms in capitals, for example

input.query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.product_ndc, p.product_name, p.dosage_form, s.substance_unii, s.substance_name
FROM sem.products p
JOIN sem.product_ingredients i ON i.product_ndc = p.product_ndc
JOIN sem.substances s ON s.substance_unii = i.substance_unii
JOIN sem.product_routes r ON r.product_ndc = p.product_ndc
WHERE s.substance_name ILIKE '%petrolatum%' AND r.route = 'OPHTHALMIC'
ORDER BY 1

queries.query:

JOIN sem.substances s ON s.substance_unii = i.substance_unii
JOIN sem.product_routes r ON r.product_ndc = p.product_ndc
WHERE s.substance_name ILIKE '%petrolatum%' AND r.route = 'OPHTHALMIC'

calls.name: describe_data
calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

FROM wh.T_RCL_PRD_DNRM r
JOIN wh.T_PRD_MSTR p ON p.PRD_SK = r.PRD_SK

JOIN wh.T_REF_CD c ON c.CD_VAL = pr.RTE_CD AND c.CD_DOM = 'RTE'

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.

  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.

      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

calls.name: describe_data
calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

WITH brand AS (
  SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK, RXCUI, CLIN_DRG_NM FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG WHERE CLIN_DRG_NM ILIKE 'empagliflozin 5 MG / metformin hydrochloride 1000 MG Oral Tablet [Synjardy]%'
),
gen AS (
  SELECT g.GNRC_CLIN_DRG_SK AS gsk FROM wh.X_BRND_GNRC g JOIN brand b ON g.BRND_CLIN_DRG_SK = b.CLIN_DRG_SK
),
mapped AS (
  SELECT p.PRD_CD FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p WHERE p.RXN_CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT gsk FROM gen)
  UNION
  SELECT p.PRD_CD FROM wh.X_NDC_RXN x JOIN wh.T_PRD_MSTR p ON x.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK WHERE x.CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT gsk FROM gen)
)

UNION ALL SELECT 'generic', c.RXCUI, c.CLIN_DRG_NM FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG c WHERE c.CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT gsk FROM gen)
UNION ALL SELECT 'product', m.PRD_CD, NULL FROM mapped m;

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.

      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

calls.name: describe_data
calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

  SELECT d.AE_SK, d.DRG_SEQ FROM wh.T_AE_DRG d WHERE d.CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK FROM c)

calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.

      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

WITH c AS (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK, RXCUI, CLIN_DRG_NM, TTY_CD FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG WHERE RXCUI = '90274885'),
m AS (
  SELECT p.PRD_CD AS product_ndc, 'own' AS src FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p JOIN c ON p.RXN_CLIN_DRG_SK = c.CLIN_DRG_SK
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.PRD_CD, 'map_' || x.SRC_CD FROM wh.X_NDC_RXN x JOIN c ON x.CLIN_DRG_SK = c.CLIN_DRG_SK JOIN wh.T_PRD_MSTR p ON p.PRD_SK = x.PRD_SK
)

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.

      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

JOIN sem.products p ON p.product_ndc = pk.product_ndc

GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
ORDER BY 3

PostgreSQL 18. The warehouse tables are in schema wh (on the search path).

CREATE TABLE wh.T_REF_CD (
    CD_DOM varchar(10) NOT NULL,
    CD_VAL varchar(16) NOT NULL,
    CD_DSC varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    SORT_ORD integer,
    PRIMARY KEY (CD_DOM, CD_VAL)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.T_SUBST_MSTR (
    SUBST_SK integer NOT NULL,
    UNII_CD varchar(10) NOT NULL,
    SUBST_NM varchar(400) NOT NULL,
    LGCY_SUBST_ID varchar(20),
    PRIMARY KEY (SUBST_SK)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.X_SALT_MOIETY (
    SUBST_SK integer NOT NULL,
    MOIETY_SUBST_SK integer NOT NULL,
    SRC_TXT varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (SUBST_SK)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.T_ORG_MSTR (
    ORG_SK integer NOT NULL,
    ORG_CD varchar(200) NOT NULL,
    ORG_NM varchar(400) NOT NULL,
    DUNS_NO varchar(9),
    PRIMARY KEY (ORG_SK)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.X_ORG_ALIAS (
    ORG_SK integer NOT NULL,
    ALIAS_NM varchar(400) NOT NULL,
    SRC_CD varchar(8) NOT NULL,
    EVID_TXT text NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (ORG_SK, ALIAS_NM)
);

CREATE TABLE wh.T_CLIN_DRG (
    CLIN_DRG_SK integer NOT NULL,
    RXCUI varchar(12) NOT NULL,

calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.

input.query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.PRD_CD AS product_ndc, p.PRD_NM, o.ORG_NM
FROM wh.T_PKG k
JOIN wh.T_ORG_MSTR o ON o.ORG_SK = k.LBLR_ORG_SK
JOIN wh.T_PRD_MSTR p ON p.PRD_SK = k.PRD_SK
JOIN wh.T_REF_CD rt ON rt.CD_DOM='PRD_TYP' AND rt.CD_VAL = p.PRD_TYP_CD
JOIN wh.T_REF_CD df ON df.CD_DOM='DSG_FRM' AND df.CD_VAL = p.DSG_FRM_CD
WHERE (o.ORG_NM ILIKE '%advanced rx%tennessee%' OR o.ORG_CD ILIKE '%advanced-rx%tennessee%'
       OR o.ORG_SK IN (SELECT a.ORG_SK FROM wh.X_ORG_ALIAS a WHERE a.ALIAS_NM ILIKE '%advanced rx%tennessee%'))
AND rt.CD_DSC = 'HUMAN PRESCRIPTION DRUG'
AND df.CD_DSC = 'INJECTION, SUSPENSION'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wh.T_PRD_RTE r JOIN wh.T_REF_CD rc ON rc.CD_DOM='RTE' AND rc.CD_VAL=r.RTE_CD WHERE r.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK AND rc.CD_DSC='INTRA-ARTICULAR')
ORDER BY 1;

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.

  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.

calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

calls.preview:
Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.

      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.

      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.

      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.

  SELECT s.SUBST_SK FROM wh.T_SUBST_MSTR s
  WHERE s.UNII_CD IN (SELECT UNII_CD FROM wh.T_SUBST_MSTR WHERE UPPER(SUBST_NM) LIKE '%RIZATRIPTAN%')

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.

input.query:
WITH cd AS (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG WHERE RXCUI = '205324'),
direct AS (
  SELECT d.AE_SK, d.DRG_SEQ FROM wh.T_AE_DRG d WHERE d.CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK FROM cd)
),
harm AS (
  SELECT x.AE_SK, x.DRG_SEQ FROM wh.X_AE_DRG_RXN x WHERE x.CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK FROM cd)
),
allr AS (SELECT AE_SK FROM direct UNION SELECT AE_SK FROM harm)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cd) AS n_sk,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT AE_SK) FROM direct) AS direct_reports,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT AE_SK) FROM harm) AS harm_reports,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM allr) AS total_reports,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.AE_SK) FROM wh.T_AE_HDR h JOIN allr a ON a.AE_SK = h.AE_SK) AS total_distinct_rpt_ids
SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK, RXCUI, CLIN_DRG_NM, TTY_CD FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG WHERE RXCUI = '205324' OR CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG WHERE RXCUI='205324')

WITH cd AS (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK, RXCUI, CLIN_DRG_NM, TTY_CD FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG WHERE RXCUI = '898346'),
own AS (SELECT p.PRD_CD AS product_ndc, 'own' AS src FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p JOIN cd ON p.RXN_CLIN_DRG_SK = cd.CLIN_DRG_SK),
mapped AS (SELECT p.PRD_CD AS product_ndc, 'map:' || m.SRC_CD AS src FROM wh.X_NDC_RXN m JOIN cd ON m.CLIN_DRG_SK = cd.CLIN_DRG_SK JOIN wh.T_PRD_MSTR p ON p.PRD_SK = m.PRD_SK)
SELECT cd.*, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT product_ndc || ' ' || src, '; ') FROM (SELECT * FROM own UNION ALL SELECT * FROM mapped) x) AS products
FROM cd;

SELECT s.SUBST_SK, s.UNII_CD, s.SUBST_NM, m.SUBST_SK AS moiety_sk, m.UNII_CD AS moiety_unii, m.SUBST_NM AS moiety_nm, x.SRC_TXT
FROM wh.T_SUBST_MSTR s
LEFT JOIN wh.X_SALT_MOIETY x ON x.SUBST_SK = s.SUBST_SK
LEFT JOIN wh.T_SUBST_MSTR m ON m.SUBST_SK = x.MOIETY_SUBST_SK
WHERE s.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%bacitracin%' OR m.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%bacitracin%' OR s.UNII_CD IN (SELECT UNII_CD FROM wh.T_SUBST_MSTR WHERE SUBST_NM ILIKE '%bacitracin%')

SELECT DISTINCT p.PRD_CD AS product_ndc, p.PRD_NM, s.SUBST_NM, s.UNII_CD, i.SUBST_SK
FROM wh.T_PRD_INGR i
JOIN wh.T_PRD_MSTR p ON p.PRD_SK = i.PRD_SK
JOIN wh.T_SUBST_MSTR s ON s.SUBST_SK = i.SUBST_SK
WHERE i.SUBST_SK IN (
  SELECT s2.SUBST_SK FROM wh.T_SUBST_MSTR s2 WHERE s2.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%bacitracin%'
  UNION SELECT x.SUBST_SK FROM wh.X_SALT_MOIETY x JOIN wh.T_SUBST_MSTR m ON m.SUBST_SK = x.MOIETY_SUBST_SK WHERE m.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%bacitracin%'
)

  (SELECT string_agg(p.PRD_CD, ',') FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p WHERE p.RXN_CLIN_DRG_SK = c.CLIN_DRG_SK) AS own_products,

WITH cd AS (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG WHERE RXCUI = '206206'),
direct AS (
  SELECT d.AE_SK, d.DRG_SEQ FROM wh.T_AE_DRG d WHERE d.CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK FROM cd)
),
harm AS (
  SELECT x.AE_SK, x.DRG_SEQ FROM wh.X_AE_DRG_RXN x WHERE x.CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK FROM cd)
),
u AS (SELECT * FROM direct UNION SELECT * FROM harm)
SELECT

 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h.AE_SK) FROM wh.T_AE_HDR h JOIN u ON u.AE_SK = h.AE_SK) AS n_ae_sk

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

queries.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RCL_NO) AS n, COUNT(*) AS rows_, MIN(RPT_DT), MAX(RPT_DT) FROM wh.T_RCL_PRD_DNRM WHERE RCL_CLS_CD = '2' AND RPT_DT >= 20260101 AND RPT_DT <= 20261231

violations.message: COUNT(*) aggregates rows of T_RCL_PRD_DNRM (one row per Recall x Recall.products), so each Recall is counted once per row. Count DISTINCT the entity's key (Recall.recall_number) or aggregate before joining.

The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

UNION ALL
SELECT 'rxn', RXN_TRM, COUNT(DISTINCT AE_SK)::text FROM wh.T_AE_RXN WHERE UPPER(TRIM(RXN_TRM)) LIKE '%HYPERAESTH%' GROUP BY RXN_TRM

FROM wh.T_AE_RXN r
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(r.RXN_TRM)) = 'HYPERAESTHESIA'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wh.T_AE_DRG d JOIN wh.T_REF_CD c ON c.CD_DOM='DRG_ROLE' AND c.CD_VAL=d.DRG_ROLE_CD

input.query:
WITH hp AS (
  SELECT s.SUBST_SK FROM wh.T_SUBST_MSTR s
  WHERE s.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%HYDROGEN PEROXIDE%'
),
cand AS (
  SELECT SUBST_SK FROM hp
  UNION
  SELECT sm.SUBST_SK FROM wh.X_SALT_MOIETY sm JOIN hp ON sm.MOIETY_SUBST_SK = hp.SUBST_SK
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.LBLR_ORG_SK) AS firms,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pi.PRD_SK) AS products,
       (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT SUBST_NM || ' ' || UNII_CD, '; ') FROM wh.T_SUBST_MSTR WHERE SUBST_SK IN (SELECT SUBST_SK FROM cand)) AS substances
FROM wh.T_PRD_INGR pi
JOIN wh.T_PKG p ON p.PRD_SK = pi.PRD_SK
WHERE pi.SUBST_SK IN (SELECT SUBST_SK FROM cand)

queries.query:

  WHERE s.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%HYDROGEN PEROXIDE%'

  UNION
  SELECT sm.SUBST_SK FROM wh.X_SALT_MOIETY sm JOIN hp ON sm.MOIETY_SUBST_SK = hp.SUBST_SK
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.LBLR_ORG_SK) AS firms,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pi.PRD_SK) AS products,

FROM wh.T_PRD_INGR pi
JOIN wh.T_PKG p ON p.PRD_SK = pi.PRD_SK
WHERE pi.SUBST_SK IN (SELECT SUBST_SK FROM cand)

WITH s AS (
  SELECT s.SUBST_SK, s.UNII_CD, s.SUBST_NM FROM wh.T_SUBST_MSTR s
  WHERE s.SUBST_NM ILIKE '%DIHYDROERGOTAMINE%'
), 
direct AS (SELECT SUBST_SK FROM s WHERE SUBST_NM ILIKE 'DIHYDROERGOTAMINE MESYLATE%'),
salt AS (SELECT x.SUBST_SK FROM wh.X_SALT_MOIETY x JOIN s ON s.SUBST_SK = x.MOIETY_SUBST_SK),
allsk AS (SELECT SUBST_SK FROM direct UNION SELECT SUBST_SK FROM salt)
SELECT 'subst' AS k, s.UNII_CD, s.SUBST_NM, (s.SUBST_SK IN (SELECT SUBST_SK FROM direct)) AS is_direct,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pk.PKG_SK) FROM wh.T_PRD_INGR i JOIN wh.T_PKG pk ON pk.PRD_SK = i.PRD_SK WHERE i.SUBST_SK = s.SUBST_SK) AS pkgs_direct,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pk.LBLR_ORG_SK) FROM wh.T_PRD_INGR i JOIN wh.T_PKG pk ON pk.PRD_SK = i.PRD_SK WHERE i.SUBST_SK = s.SUBST_SK) AS labelers_direct,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pk.LBLR_ORG_SK) FROM wh.T_PRD_INGR i JOIN wh.T_PKG pk ON pk.PRD_SK = i.PRD_SK WHERE i.SUBST_SK IN (SELECT SUBST_SK FROM allsk)) AS labelers_all
FROM s;"

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

input.query:
WITH cd AS (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG WHERE RXCUI = '94646865'),
m AS (
  SELECT p.PRD_CD FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p JOIN wh.X_NDC_RXN x ON x.PRD_SK = p.PRD_SK WHERE x.CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK FROM cd)
  UNION
  SELECT p.PRD_CD FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p WHERE p.RXN_CLIN_DRG_SK IN (SELECT CLIN_DRG_SK FROM cd)
)
SELECT PRD_CD FROM m ORDER BY PRD_CD;

SELECT c.RXCUI, c.CLIN_DRG_NM, c.TTY_CD, (SELECT count(*) FROM wh.X_NDC_RXN x WHERE x.CLIN_DRG_SK = c.CLIN_DRG_SK) map_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM wh.T_PRD_MSTR p WHERE p.RXN_CLIN_DRG_SK = c.CLIN_DRG_SK) direct_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM wh.X_BRND_GNRC g WHERE g.BRND_CLIN_DRG_SK = c.CLIN_DRG_SK) gen_cnt FROM wh.T_CLIN_DRG c WHERE c.RXCUI LIKE '%94646865%' OR c.RXCUI = '94646865' OR c.CLIN_DRG_NM IS NULL AND false;

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

Ontology of the drug data (MONOGRAPH model 2.2.0), with its mapping to the warehouse.
The data is in a legacy warehouse, PostgreSQL 18, schema wh (on the search path). Every class and
property below says where it is stored. Join a reference column to the identity column of the class it
references; finer tables (one row per list item or set member) repeat their owner's row, so count
distinct identities when counting owners.

Class Substance: A chemical or biological substance identified by its FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier.
  stored in T_SUBST_MSTR, one row per Substance; identity SUBST_SK; business key unii = UNII_CD.
  - unii (text, exactly one): FDA UNII code.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.UNII_CD.
  - name (text, exactly one): Preferred name.
      stored in T_SUBST_MSTR.SUBST_NM.
  - active_moiety (embedded MoietyLink, at most one): For a salt, ester or other form, its active moiety (for example ampicillin sodium to ampicillin). Absent when the substance is its own moiety or no label states one.
      stored in X_SALT_MOIETY (one row per active_moiety item), SUBST_SK is the owning Substance.
      moiety (reference to Substance, exactly one): The active moiety (parent substance). Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.MOIETY_SUBST_SK references Substance (Substance identity).
      source (text, exactly one): Provenance: 'spl:<set id>' of the label that states it. Stored in X_SALT_MOIETY.SRC_TXT.

Class Organization: A company acting as manufacturer, labeler or recalling firm.
  store

input.query:
with s as (select SUBST_SK from T_SUBST_MSTR where upper(SUBST_NM)='NYSTATIN' union select m.SUBST_SK from X_SALT_MOIETY m join T_SUBST_MSTR t on t.SUBST_SK=m.MOIETY_SUBST_SK where upper(t.SUBST_NM)='NYSTATIN')
select count(distinct p.LBLR_ORG_SK), (select count(*) from s) from T_PKG p join T_PRD_INGR i on i.PRD_SK=p.PRD_SK where i.SUBST_SK in (select SUBST_SK from s)

queries.query:
with s as (select SUBST_SK from T_SUBST_MSTR where upper(SUBST_NM)='NYSTATIN' union select m.SUBST_SK from X_SALT_MOIETY m join T_SUBST_MSTR t on t.SUBST_SK=m.MOIETY_SUBST_SK where upper(t.SUBST_NM)='NYSTATIN')
select count(distinct p.LBLR_ORG_SK), (select count(*) from s) from T_PKG p join T_PRD_INGR i on i.PRD_SK=p.PRD_SK where i.SUBST_SK in (select SUBST_SK from s)

details.question: How many different firms label packages for products whose active ingredients include NYSTATIN?

input.query: select count(distinct r.rcl_no) from t_rcl_prd_dnrm r join t_prd_mstr p on p.prd_sk=r.prd_sk join t_ref_cd c on c.cd_dom='DSG_FRM' and c.cd_val=p.dsg_frm_cd where c.cd_dsc='TABLET, DELAYED RELEASE' and r.rcl_cls_cd='2'

queries.query: select count(distinct r.rcl_no) from t_rcl_prd_dnrm r join t_prd_mstr p on p.prd_sk=r.prd_sk join t_ref_cd c on c.cd_dom='DSG_FRM' and c.cd_val=p.dsg_frm_cd where c.cd_dsc='TABLET, DELAYED RELEASE' and r.rcl_cls_cd='2'

details.question: Count the Class II recalls naming a product whose dosage form is 'TABLET, DELAYED RELEASE'.

input.query: select o.org_sk,o.org_nm,(select count(distinct r.prd_sk) from t_rcl_prd_dnrm r join t_pkg p on p.prd_sk=r.prd_sk where p.lblr_org_sk=o.org_sk and r.rcl_cls_cd='2') c from t_org_mstr o where org_nm ilike 'granules pharm%'

details.question: How many of Granules Pharmaceuticals Inc.'s products appear in a Class II recall?
